results.title: Who is really profiting from Myanmar’s jade?
results.description:
Who is really profiting from Myanmar’s jade? 
---#WhatsHappeningInMyanmar
Evidence reveals a network of illegal jade mining blocks in Hpakant, Kachin State, granted by KIA insurgents. With daily shipments of fuel entering from China to power these unauthorized operations, local communities are taking a stand, loudly protesting the ruthless exploitation of state wealth by KIA insurgents and its network.

results.title: China mines more rare earths than the rest of the world combined.
results.description:
China mines more rare earths than the rest of the world combined.

Rare earth mine production, 2025 (tonnes, estimates)

1. 🇨🇳 China: 270,000
2. 🇺🇸 United States: 51,000
3. 🇦🇺 Australia: 29,000
4. 🇲🇲 Myanmar: 22,000
5. 🇹🇭 Thailand: 4,800
6. 🇮🇳 India: 2,900
7. 🇲🇬 Madagascar: 2,700
8. 🇷🇺 Russia: 2,600

Source: US Geological Survey
